import fastsim

veh = fastsim.Vehicle.from_resource("2021_Hyundai_Sonata_Hybrid_Blue_thrml.yaml")
cyc = fastsim.Cycle.from_resource("udds.csv")

# ---- overrides requested in the GUI ----
d = veh.to_dict()
d["mass_kilograms"] = 1750.0
d["chassis"]["drag_coef"] = 0.3
d["chassis"]["wheel_rr_coef"] = 0.0082
d["pt_type"]["HEV"]["fc"]["pwr_out_max_watts"] = 120000.0
d["pt_type"]["HEV"]["res"]["ess_init_soc"] = 0.7
veh = fastsim.Vehicle.from_dict(d)

veh.set_save_interval(1)
sim = fastsim.SimDrive(veh, cyc)
sim.run()

# ---- results ----
res = veh.pt_type.HEV
dist_mi = sim.dist_meters / 1609.34
fuel_kwh = sim.fc.energy_fuel_joules / 3.6e6
elec_kwh = sim.res.energy_out_electrical_joules / 3.6e6
mpgge = dist_mi / (fuel_kwh / 33.705) if fuel_kwh > 0 else float("nan")

print(f"distance            {dist_mi:10.3f} mi")
print(f"fuel energy         {fuel_kwh:10.3f} kWh")
print(f"electricity used    {elec_kwh:10.3f} kWh")
print(f"fuel economy        {mpgge:10.2f} mpgge")
print(f"avg speed           {sim.mph_ach.mean():10.2f} mph")
print(f"max speed           {sim.mph_ach.max():10.2f} mph")
print(f"trace match         {100.0:10.1f} %")
